mapper.select: SELECT id, title, cover_url, content, registration_start, registration_end, activity_start, activity_end, max_participants, current_participants, status, create_time, update_time FROM community_activity WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('REGISTRATING', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY activity_start ASC

SELECT id, title, cover_url, content, registration_start, registration_end, activity_start, activity_end, max_participants, current_participants, status, create_time, update_time FROM community_activity WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE community_activity SET current_participants = current_participants + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND current_participants < max_participants
UPDATE community_activity SET current_participants = current_participants - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND current_participants > 0
